units.source_text: 1950年3月17日，我修完大谷大学的预科课程。

en.t: On March 17, 1950, I completed the preparatory course at Otani University.

units.source_text: 第三天，即19日正好是我满21岁的生日。

en.t: The third day, the 19th, happened to be my twenty-first birthday.

units.source_text: 预料三年级的成绩是相当可观的，名次是对人中的第对名。

en.t: My third-year grades were expected to be fairly respectable, with my ranking listed as a certain place among a certain number of students.

units.source_text: 各科中成绩最差的是国语，42分。

en.t: Among all the subjects, my worst grade was in Japanese, with 42 points.

units.source_text: 旷课时数在总时数的610小时中占218小时，超过三分之一。

en.t: My absences amounted to 218 hours out of a total of 610, more than one third.

units.source_text: 尽管如此，多亏佛爷的慈悲心，这所大学没有留级生，所以我能够进人本科。

en.t: Even so, thanks to the Buddha's mercy, this university had no students repeat a year, so I was able to enter the regular undergraduate course.

units.source_text: 老师也默认了这一事实。

en.t: The teachers also tacitly accepted this fact.
